name: SportsMOT: Multi-Actor Tracking in Sports Scenes
description: SportsMOT is a multi-object tracking benchmark focused on fast-paced, multi-actor movements in team sports broadcasts. It consists of 240 video clips (average 485 frames per clip, totaling ~116,400 frames) collected across three sports categories: basketball, football (soccer), and volleyball. The dataset captures key challenges in athletic tracking, including high-speed player movements, non-linear trajectories, abrupt direction reversals, shared team jerseys, and rapid pan-tilt-zoom camera motion. Annotated with full bounding boxes and identities following the MOT Challenge format, partitioned into 45 train, 45 validation, and 150 test clips.
